description: This file contains Perl code implementing Montgomery multiplication routines and related functions for x86_64 architecture, including multiple optimized versions with unrolling and instruction set enhancements. It also includes exception handling code for Windows 64-bit systems.

methods.name: bn_mul_mont
methods.description: Performs Montgomery multiplication for large integers on x86_64, with optimizations for different input sizes and instruction sets.

methods.name: bn_mul4x_mont
methods.description: Optimized 4x multiplication routine for Montgomery multiplication with unrolled loops.

methods.name: bn_sqr8x_mont
methods.description: Optimized 8x squaring routine for Montgomery squaring with unrolled loops.

methods.name: bn_mulx4x_mont
methods.description: Further optimized 4x multiplication routine utilizing advanced instruction set features.
